name: scene-model-v1
note: Starting size of the scene model, chosen from the S0 training-step measurement by the rule recorded in that measurement. It is a starting configuration: later milestones may replace it with a new version, never by editing this one.
placeholder_parameters_note: Counted on the placeholder, whose input vocabulary is a guess. The real scene model's count will differ slightly once the adapter and generator set the vocabulary.

chosen_from.statement: d384-l6 (10.73M parameters) is the eligible size nearest the middle of the planned range. Neither memory nor time was the limit for it at batch 64.
